item.title: Diesel Price Hike: Freight Charges Increased by 4% Across Pakistan
item.description: Islamabad – The price of high-speed diesel (HSD) in Pakistan has jumped by Rs 11.30 per litre, reaching Rs 268.38. In response, the Pakistan Goods Transport Alliance has raised freight fares by 4% nationwide.
